column1: # NexaCore Solutions - Enterprise AI Support Copilot Knowledge Base
This is a fictional dataset created for a RAG/OCR learning project.
## Business problem
Employees lose time searching across IT policies
column4: and incident runbooks. Some source documents are normal digital PDFs
column5: while some legacy operational documents are scanned PDFs with no text layer. The goal is to build an AI support copilot that retrieves approved company information
column8: and refuses to invent policy when the answer is not in the knowledge base.

column1: ## Files
- 01_IT_Security_Policy.pdf - native text PDF
- 02_Password_and_MFA_Policy.pdf - native text PDF
- 03_VPN_Troubleshooting_Guide_SCANNED.pdf - raster-only scanned PDF; OCR required
- 04_Remote_Access_Policy.pdf - native text PDF
- 05_Incident_Response_Quick_Runbook_SCANNED.pdf - raster-only scanned PDF; OCR required
- 06_IT_Support_FAQ.pdf - native text PDF with a table
- golden_questions.json - evaluation questions with expected answers/sources
- document_manifest.csv - document type and OCR requirement
## Phase 1 target architecture
Native PDFs -> parser -> chunks -> embeddings -> vector store
Scanned PDFs -> OCR -> extracted text -> chunks -> embeddings -> vector store
User question -> retrieval -> LLM -> answer + citations
## Definition of done
1. All six documents are indexed.
2. OCR is used for the two scanned PDFs.
3. Questions Q01-Q12 can be tested against the system.
4. Answers cite the correct source document(s).
5. Q10 must be refused as unsupported rather than hallucinated.
